Nova Robotics Onboarding Handbook

Welcome to Nova Robotics. This handbook covers the essentials for new hires.

Section 1: Orientation
All new hires must complete a one-day orientation session in their first week.
Orientation is held every Monday morning at 9:00 AM in the Atlas conference room.

Section 2: Equipment
New hires receive a laptop, a security badge, and a parking permit on day one.
Replacement badges cost twenty-five dollars and can be obtained from facilities.

Section 3: Safety
Safety glasses are required at all times in the lab.
Fire extinguishers are located near every exit on every floor.

Section 4: Contacts
For HR questions, contact Maria Lopez in the People Operations team.
For IT support, file a ticket via the internal helpdesk portal.
